Metadata Integration for Spam Reviews Detection on Vietnamese E-Commerce Websites
The problem of detecting spam reviews (opinions) has received significant attention in recent years, especially with the rapid development of e-commerce. Spam reviews are often classified based on comment content, but in some cases, it is insufficient for models to accurately determine the review label.
